title: Jodi
desc: After receiving a random call from Shalini, Vinod falls in love with her. When his best friend also falls for her, he tries to sabotage Vinod's chances and woo her on his own.

title: Premier Padmini
desc: Struggling with a lackluster career, a failed marriage and a rocky relationship with his son, Vinayaka gains hope and a new perspective on life when he meets Nanjundi.

title: Veeran
desc: Kumaran, a teenage boy, gets struck by lightning and goes into a coma. He wakes up realising that he has superhuman abilities post the accident.

title: RX Soori
desc: A dreaded criminal, Paritaala Soori, terrorises the Rayalaseema province of Andhra Pradesh with his unlawful activities. Things take a turn when he falls in love with his childhood friend.

title: Bheema Theeradalli
desc: Chandappa, a dreaded dacoit, gets deceived by a corrupt politician, Shashikanth. But fate intervenes when the latter's sister ends up falling in love with Chandappa.

title: Jogi
desc: After a crime lord is murdered by Madesha, Nivedhitha, a journalist, sets out to meet him. She ends up meeting an old woman and promises to help her find her son, who is none other than Madesha.
